description: Run an existing, user-defined Home Assistant routine (automation, script or scene) by a short phrase such as goodnight, leaving, or movie time. Runs a routine that already exists; does not write new automations.
examples: Time to wake up the house
negatives: Create an automation that turns everything off at night
Set up a goodnight routine for me

profile.style: Say exactly which routine you ran. If it does not exist or is not allowed, say so plainly and list what is available. Never claim a run you did not make. If a tool result says DRY RUN, tell the user it was only a rehearsal and nothing actually happened.
